I can't process a refund without going through the normal steps. Every return or exchange needs your explicit confirmation before I take action, and I can only act on orders that belong to the account I'm helping with.

To verify your identity, please give me either the email address on your account, or your first name, last name, and zip code. Once you're verified, I can look up order #W9980894 and check its status. If it's eligible for a return, I'll list the exact details and ask you to confirm before anything is submitted.
